name: Nazar Boncuğu
notes: Small design: 21 closed panes counted (5 concentric subject panes and 16 alternating background sectors), within target 12–22. Subject and background use separate alternating colour pairs. Visually inspected: closed outlines, separated T junctions, no X crossings or loose lines, generous pane widths. Generated circular request rendered as a slightly elongated oval. Mild fill shading remains after one correction attempt; retained the original opaque-white version because the correction introduced transparency and did not remove shading. No subject mask required. Design sheet only; not imported or published.
